bestBets.overview: ANY QUESTIONS hit the line well fresh, strips fitter and will appreciate the rise in trip. PLACID ROM is knocking on the door and is due for a change of luck. COSTA STAR wasn't beaten far latest and will only need to hold form to go close again. RADIO SILENCE resumes and wouldn't totally shock in suitable company.

raceTips.comment:
Nearly all of these raced each other at the previous meeting. Thought ANY QUESTIONS had the most scope for improvement having only his first start on the dirt, missing it away and working his way into fourth. Smaller and similiar field with another furlong and look at the surface. That'll do me.
COSTA STAR was wide throughout in that same race and is continuing to knock on the door but has found one better regularly. 29 start maiden.
PLACID ROM is lightly raced and likely to come out on the pace.
RADIO SILENCE has some okay metro form lines - trial was fair and has to make the transition to the dirt. 
Dame Dargent and Black Cilla go around massive odds for an 8 horse field.

bestBets.overview: CORN COB wasn't beaten far latest and will only need to hold form to go close again. LOMBADINA will find this easier than last start and can improve sharply for new stable. RED REBEL won well latest and can go on with it here. PLAYING QUEST was impressive winning latest and must be rated highly. DAIYAMONDO mixes form but best is good enough. HARD QUESTIONS gets a soft run from gate 1 and will be in this a long way off a nice first up win.

raceTips.comment:
PLAYING QUEST bolted in last start. Extending 5 lengths without really being tested. Question on what he beat and he has ben beaten by RED REBEL when they met previously but chalking that down to him not appreciating the Roebourne surface.
SET THE SCENE is back to the scene of his 2024 campaign success. He was first up over the 1000m (trial!) and ran into fifth. Out to the mile is what he needs and gets in with 54.5 - best roughie of the day (might be going one race early though).
CORN COB and RED REBEL - nothing between these two. Literally only a head last start.

bestBets.overview: THE COOLAKIN KING wasn't beaten far latest and will only need to hold form to go close again. SIMPLY ROSSO gets a soft run from gate 1 and will be in this a long way. BUSY FINGERS looks suited back to 1000m and can improve sharply. SHOOTNG KONTIKI is knocking on the door and is due for a change of luck. MARS MISSION mixes form but best is good enough. KIMBERLEY CURRENCY off back to back wins must be rated highly.

raceTips.comment:
Looks to be a good amount of pace on paper here so I've landed on the two gallopers who will appreciate being able to run on in BUSY FINGERS and MARS MISSION. 
BUSY FINGERS was a good run at his first go on the dirt and then didnt have any luck at Roebourne.
MARS MISSION  finished less than half a length of Kimberley Currency two starts prior and gets 3kg to turn the tables.
SIMPLY ROSSO could be the handlebars down leader the with 5kg claiming apprentice on board and KIMBERLEY CURRENCY has put back to back wins on the board but the awkward gate makes things interesting here.

bestBets.overview: BLOWIN' SMOKE mixes form but best is good enough. YES I BELIEVE is a consistent type who will be in this a long way as usual. ALMA MATER gets a soft run from the good gate and will make presence felt as usual. TANGO RHYTHM broke maiden status latest and can go on with it here. KUNAPIPI is knocking on the door and is due for a change of luck.

raceTips.comment:
TANGO RYTHYM didnt beat much to take out her maiden but she did it in style and clocked the fastest closing 600/400/200 sections of the entire card. Step up to the C3 will be a test but the race shape looks great and she can make it two in a line.
YES I BELIEVE beat most of these home last start when making up a stack of ground through the field. 4kg claiming apprentice on. Blinkers on. Needs to jump well and hold a position.
BLOWIN SMOKE is a frustrating galloper - clearly has potential but has a habit of laying in badly.
ALMA MATER wasnt right last start but won well the start prior.

bestBets.overview: ONLY US has won all 5 starts this time in and will prove hard to beat again. CANDLELIGHT SHERIF is knocking on the door and is due for a change of luck. MR HOLLYWOOD broke through for overdue win latest and it wouldn't shock to see him go on with it here. ODIN OMEN is a consistent type who will make presence felt as usual. FRIES WITH THAT next best.

raceTips.comment:
ONLY US will be the Carnarvon horse of the year - unbeaten - 5/5. This will be a proper test. 62kg over the 1750m with a few of these not that far off him. Great test. 
Thinking that the Aaron Pateman team have figured out TIFF'S LAD. Looked a little underdone at his first start with the team and the race was a crawl/sprint (not his go). Second up he improved to be beaten 6L by our favourite. Bar Plates come off for the first time, third up on the dirt. Let him run!
ONLY US. 5/5 need I saw more.
CANDLELIGHT SHERIF only went down to him by 0.3lengths last start and gets a 1kg swing.
SHABALALA roughie of the day. This guy can run, just needs a bit of fitness and while he was beaten 8lengths by ONLY US last start watch the replay - absolutely no chance to build into the race with a hose falling back into him at the 600. Great Prelude

bestBets.overview: SMART RETURN won well latest and can go on with it here. SOARING SOLO will press forward and be in this a long way as usual. ADDICTIVE DREAM is knocking on the door and is due for a change of luck. ON THE CHARGE strips fitter for first up run and must be respected. SHE IS ALL MAGIC is knocking on the door and is due for a change of luck. OUR KIWI PRINCESS wouldn't shock if can find best.
bestBets.suggestedBet: She Is All Magic - Each Way

raceTips.comment:
Tough race the last here with multiple winning chances. CHAMPEZE has taken nicely to dirt racing after improving last start when blundering the start severely. Senior rider on today and with a bit of predicted pace she could be the one to run on.
SMART RETURN was very good at her first run on the dirt when being kept wide. Stays in the same class and distance - no reason she cant win again.
IRONCLAD BOY is nicely weighted with the claim here and OUR KIWI PRINCESS was a similiar watch to CHAMPEZE but 61kg from close to last will be an almighty effort.
